en.title: Mobile Scorekeeper Portal Login
en.excerpt: Walkthrough of scorekeeper authentication on mobile devices, lane selection, and device connection checks.
en.content:
Accessing the Mobile Portal

Scorekeepers open any standard mobile web browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) on a smartphone or tablet and navigate to archeris.net/scorekeeper/login.

Entering the 5-Character Code

Type the assigned 5-character code into the large-format input box. The system automatically converts letters to uppercase and validates the code against the active tournament registry.

Selecting Assigned Target Butts

Upon successful code validation, the screen displays the assigned target butt (e.g., Target Butt 12) along with athlete names in positions 12A, 12B, 12C, and 12D. Confirm the names match the archers present at the target.

Connection Indicator & PWA Installation

The top status bar displays a green connection dot indicating live server synchronization. Scorekeepers can tap Add to Home Screen to run Archeris as a full-screen standalone application without browser URL bars.
